_metadata.description: Synthetic IT incident data for POC demonstrations
_metadata.note: PLACEHOLDER: Replace with ServiceNow integration for production

incidents.description: Multiple customers reporting 503 Service Unavailable errors when accessing the main API gateway. Started at 14:30 UTC. Affects approximately 40% of requests.
incidents.workaround: Customers can retry requests with exponential backoff

incidents.shortDescription: Azure SQL database connection pool exhaustion
incidents.description: Database connection pool reaching max limit causing application timeouts. Connection count at 450/500. Performance degradation across reporting services.
incidents.rootCause: Memory leak in connection handling code
incidents.workaround: Restarting application pods temporarily resolves issue

incidents.shortDescription: SSL certificate expiration warning for api.atos.net
incidents.description: SSL certificate for api.atos.net expires in 7 days. Certificate renewal process needs to be initiated immediately.
Worker node k8s-worker-03 reporting memory pressure. Multiple pods being evicted. Node at 92% memory utilization.
incidents.rootCause: Logging sidecar consuming excessive memory due to verbose logging enabled
incidents.resolution: Reduced logging verbosity and added resource limits to sidecar containers

incidents.shortDescription: Email delivery delays for notification service
incidents.description: Customer notification emails delayed by 2-4 hours. SMTP queue backed up with 15,000 pending messages.
incidents.rootCause: SMTP relay server rate limiting triggered due to spike in transactional emails
incidents.resolution: Increased rate limit and added additional SMTP relay servers to the pool

incidents.shortDescription: VPN connectivity issues for remote workers
incidents.description: Multiple employees unable to connect to corporate VPN. GlobalProtect client showing authentication failures.
incidents.rootCause: RADIUS server certificate mismatch after unplanned certificate rotation
incidents.resolution: Updated VPN gateway configuration with correct certificate chain

incidents.description: CRM data sync between internal systems and Salesforce failing with OAuth token errors. Last successful sync was 18 hours ago.
incidents.workaround: Manual data export/import as temporary measure

incidents.shortDescription: High CPU on production web servers
incidents.description: Web server cluster showing sustained 95%+ CPU utilization. Response times increased from 200ms to 2000ms average.
incidents.rootCause: Regex DoS vulnerability triggered by malformed input
incidents.resolution: Deployed hotfix with input validation and optimized regex patterns

incidents.description: Network printer PRN-F3-01 not accepting print jobs. Print queue shows 45 pending jobs stuck in queue.
incidents.rootCause: Print spooler service crashed after large print job
incidents.resolution: Cleared print queue and restarted spooler service

incidents.description: ITSM portal loading slowly. Page load times exceeding 15 seconds. Users reporting timeout errors.
incidents.rootCause: Scheduled report generation consuming excessive instance resources
incidents.resolution: Rescheduled heavy reports to off-peak hours and optimized queries
